sufficiency_allowed_fields_defined.instructions: Does the shown material include the definitions of the plan question and plan field structures that projection reads, so that the rule deciding which fields enter a payload is stated without relying on definitions that are not shown?

criteria.true: The structures projection reads are defined in the given material
criteria.false: Projection reads a structure whose definition is absent from the given material

payload_reads_only_own_lists.instructions: Does projectQuestion build the payload by iterating only the question inputs list and the question policyRefs list that it is given?

criteria.true: The payload is built only from the two lists on the given question
criteria.false: The payload construction reads other structures or lists
